reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the pocket-sized sachet that tears open with one hand, because I forget pills at home and live out of my tote, so I can throw a few in for the gym and trips. I'd pick the plain one since I can see exactly what's in it, and I'd try one box before committing.
objection: Thirty bucks is a lot on my budget when a bottle of magnesium at the drugstore is half that, and I'm paying extra for the sachet and the QR code. The Complex only has 3 forms when others claim 8 or 14, so it doesn't look like a better deal.
would_change_my_mind: A lower price per box, like a first-box discount or a bundle, or a trial pack so I can try it before paying full price.
